heard: From Gilgal we walk side by side Elijah said, stay here, I must go But I swore I would not leave his side As surely as the Lord lives, no Give me a double portion of this field Before you are taken from my sight If I see you go, it shall be given If not, then let me be in the night At Bethel the prophets asked me then Do you know who is being taken away? I said, yes, I know, beast
